item.text:
Subject: Moving Help

Hi [Friend’s Name],

Thanks so much for offering to help me move! The move turned out to be smaller and easier than I expected, so I won’t need a full day of assistance after all. If you’re still available, I could really use your help for about an hour—mostly carrying a few boxes and loading some furniture. Of course, no pressure at all if your schedule has changed. I really appreciate your kindness and willingness to help, and even that one hour would make a big difference. I’ll let you know the exact time and details soon.

Thanks again!

Best,  
[Your Name]
